facts.fact: ICT Secretary Mary Kerema told WSO2Con Africa that a new interoperability platform to let government entities share data is still in development, alongside the launched Government Enterprise Architecture (Techweez report).

systems.owner: State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy

facts.fact: Cybernetica reports a GIZ, EU and ESTDEV-funded pilot, April 2024 to June 2025, for Kenya's Ministry of ICT and ICT Authority that built an X-Road-based test environment platform with two demo integrated public services and a service catalogue.

note: The only exchange layer described is a health-programme interoperability layer (eight connected systems, 2022 report, no month), a single ministry's sector integration and so class other; no national government exchange platform is stated.

facts.fact: Kenya's ICT PS John Tanui said at WSO2Con Africa in Nairobi on 23 September 2026 that the government is building an Enterprise Platform to orchestrate data and services across government, linking institutions' systems through secure APIs; no live date or connected-system count is given.
